revision_scope: HEAD plus current working-tree changes; revision alone does not identify the audited tree

scope.exclusions: Tests, fixtures, server sources and *.generated.* excluded from frontend caller scan; backend test/fixture sources excluded from route scan.

methodology.route_detection: Express verb registrations and statically traceable router mounts from server.ts; direct register functions, nested routers, simple router factories and literal route-helper arguments followed.
methodology.caller_detection: fetch, axios.<verb>, and runCommand (including imported aliases); direct wrapper call sites supply literal arguments where possible; method defaults to GET where known. Derived records retain both transport and call-site evidence.
methodology.interpretation: Static matches are path/method evidence only, not proof of a reachable UI or working contract. Dynamic pathname segments are possible matches only; query interpolation does not make a pathname dynamic; absence is not proof of an orphan or defect.
limitations: Dynamic paths, variable request objects, custom transports, command names, loop-generated routes, middleware routing, conditional mounts, reachability and API schemas are not fully resolved; unresolved verb registrations are restricted to mounted or router-named receivers to avoid non-Express .get/.post calls.

Parameter and factory tracing is approximate and does not model runtime control flow, auth, route ordering, HTTP semantics or Vercel deployment. Middleware dispatch (including sandbox report/balance proxies) is not expanded; review middleware_mounts_for_review.
This scan excludes tests/fixtures and does not establish actual UI screen reachability, correctness, or coverage. Review unresolved and unmounted registrations manually.
